title: Decimals
examples: Teacher, how do I know where to put the decimal point?
Can you show me tenths and hundredths on the number line?
What is the difference between 0.3 and 3/10?

explain.say: Today we are learning about decimals. Say this number: zero point six. This means six tenths.
The first spot after the point is for tenths. The second spot is for hundredths. The third spot is for thousandths.
Look at zero point twenty-five. This means twenty hundredths. It has a number in the hundredths place.
Now let us place zero point three on the number line. It is three jumps from zero, past the tenths mark.
If we look at zero point one two, it is one hundredth and two thousandths. It is between one tenth and one-quarter.

faq.q: What is the difference between a decimal and a fraction?
faq.a: A decimal is just another way to write a fraction. The point separates the whole number from the parts.
asks: How are decimals and fractions related?
Is 0.5 the same as five over ten?

faq.q: When do I use hundredths instead of tenths?
faq.a: You use hundredths when the number goes past the tenths mark. It means out of one hundred parts.
asks: When do I need the second spot after the point?

faq.q: How do I know if I need to write a zero?
faq.a: You must write a zero if a place value is empty. For example, zero point zero seven needs that zero.
asks: If I write 0.7, do I need to write 0.70?
Must I put a zero in the middle?

faq.a: Yes, you compare them by looking at the places from left to right. Start with the biggest place value first.
asks: How do I order these decimals correctly?

faq.q: What does the number line help me with?
faq.a: The number line helps you see the size of the decimal. It shows where the number sits between whole numbers.
asks: Is the number line for decimals important?
Does the number line show me the value?

facts: The first digit after the decimal point is the tenths place.
The second digit after the decimal point is the hundredths place.
The third digit after the decimal point is the thousandths place.
Zero point one is the same as one tenth.

quiz.say: Which number is the same as seven hundredths?
quiz.why: The zero in the tenths place and the seven in the hundredths place make zero point zero seven.

wrong.0: This is wrong because zero point seven zero means seven tenths, not seven hundredths.
wrong.2: This is wrong because zero point seven means seven tenths, not seven hundredths.
wrong.3: This is wrong because seven divided by ten is seven tenths, not seven hundredths.

quiz.say: Which number is smaller than zero point five?
quiz.why: Comparing place by place, the tenths place is the same, but forty-nine hundredths is less than fifty hundredths.

wrong.0: This is wrong because six tenths is bigger than five tenths.
wrong.1: This is wrong because zero point five is exactly the same as zero point five zero.
wrong.2: This is wrong because zero point four means four tenths, which is smaller than forty-nine hundredths.

quiz.say: Order these from smallest to largest: zero point three, zero point zero three, zero point three zero.

options.show: zero point zero three, zero point three zero, zero point three
options.say: zero point zero three, zero point three zero, zero point three

options.show: zero point three zero, zero point three, zero point zero three
options.say: zero point three zero, zero point three, zero point zero three

options.show: zero point zero three, zero point three, zero point three zero
options.say: zero point zero three, zero point three, zero point three zero

options.show: zero point three, zero point three zero, zero point zero three
options.say: zero point three, zero point three zero, zero point zero three

quiz.why: We compare the tenths place first. Zero point zero three has zero in the tenths place, making it the smallest.

wrong.0: This is wrong because zero point three is smaller than zero point three zero.
wrong.1: This is wrong because zero point three zero is not the largest number.
wrong.3: This is wrong because zero point zero three is clearly the smallest number here.
